title: IREN roughly-two-month reversal hypothesis

discovery_data.use: visual hypothesis generation only; excluded from the primary test

hypothesis: IREN has a stable roughly two-month boom-bust tendency: a 42-trading-day return predicts an opposite-signed next 42-trading-day return, including after adjustment for Bitcoin and QQQ returns.

primary_test.sampling: non-overlapping blocks aligned to the first complete IREN return
statistics: lag-1 Pearson correlation of consecutive 42-day log returns
one-sided permutation p-value for negative correlation
primary_test.factor_adjustment: OLS of daily IREN log returns on same-date BTC-USD and QQQ log returns; repeat block test on residual sums

predeclared_success_gate: raw lag correlation is negative with one-sided permutation p < 0.05
factor-adjusted lag correlation is negative with one-sided permutation p < 0.05
at least 60% of adjacent blocks have opposite signs
lag correlation is negative in both chronological halves

robustness_not_selection.rule: alternate horizons and phases cannot rescue a failed primary 42-day test

interpretation_rule: Failure means the one-year oscillation is not evidence of a stable, timeable two-month cycle. It does not prove that IREN never mean-reverts or that fundamentals/news do not matter.
